Problem Statement Quotient Rule & Composite Chain Rule
Find the derivative with respect to xxx of the function:
y=cos⁡2xcos⁡(x2)y = \frac{\cos^2 x}{\cos(x^2)}y=cos(x2)cos2x​
STEP 1 প্রদত্ত ত্রিকোণমিতিক ভগ্নাংশ ফাংশনটি উল্লেখ করি (Given Function)
y=cos⁡2xcos⁡(x2)=(cos⁡x)2cos⁡(x2)y = \frac{\cos^2 x}{\cos(x^2)} = \frac{(\cos x)^2}{\cos(x^2)}y=cos(x2)cos2x​=cos(x2)(cosx)2​
STEP 2 ভাগ বিধি (Quotient Rule) অনুসারে অন্তরীকরণ সূত্র স্থাপন করি (Setting up Quotient Rule)
dydx=cos⁡(x2)⋅ddx(cos⁡2x)−cos⁡2x⋅ddx[cos⁡(x2)][cos⁡(x2)]2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{\cos(x^2) \cdot \frac{d}{dx}(\cos^2 x) - \cos^2 x \cdot \frac{d}{dx}\left[\cos(x^2)\right]}{\left[\cos(x^2)\right]^2}dxdy​=[cos(x2)]2cos(x2)⋅dxd​(cos2x)−cos2x⋅dxd​[cos(x2)]​
STEP 3 লবের পদ u=cos⁡2xu = \cos^2 xu=cos2x-এর অন্তরজ নির্ণয় করি (Differentiating Numerator via Power & Chain Rule)
ddx(cos⁡2x)=2cos⁡x⋅ddx(cos⁡x)=2cos⁡x(−sin⁡x)=−2sin⁡xcos⁡x=−sin⁡2x\frac{d}{dx}(\cos^2 x) = 2\cos x \cdot \frac{d}{dx}(\cos x) = 2\cos x(-\sin x) = -2\sin x\cos x = -\sin 2xdxd​(cos2x)=2cosx⋅dxd​(cosx)=2cosx(−sinx)=−2sinxcosx=−sin2x
STEP 4 হরের পদ v=cos⁡(x2)v = \cos(x^2)v=cos(x2)-এর অন্তরজ নির্ণয় করি (Differentiating Denominator via Chain Rule)
ddx[cos⁡(x2)]=−sin⁡(x2)⋅ddx(x2)=−sin⁡(x2)⋅(2x)=−2xsin⁡(x2)\frac{d}{dx}\left[\cos(x^2)\right] = -\sin(x^2) \cdot \frac{d}{dx}(x^2) = -\sin(x^2) \cdot (2x) = -2x\sin(x^2)dxd​[cos(x2)]=−sin(x2)⋅dxd​(x2)=−sin(x2)⋅(2x)=−2xsin(x2)
STEP 5 মানগুলি সূত্রে স্থাপন করে বীজগাণিতিক সরলীকরণ করি (Substituting into Formula & Simplifying)
dydx=cos⁡(x2)[−2sin⁡xcos⁡x]−cos⁡2x[−2xsin⁡(x2)]cos⁡2(x2)=2xcos⁡2xsin⁡(x2)−sin⁡2xcos⁡(x2)cos⁡2(x2)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{\cos(x^2)[-2\sin x\cos x] - \cos^2 x[-2x\sin(x^2)]}{\cos^2(x^2)} = \frac{2x\cos^2 x\sin(x^2) - \sin 2x\cos(x^2)}{\cos^2(x^2)}dxdy​=cos2(x2)cos(x2)[−2sinxcosx]−cos2x[−2xsin(x2)]​=cos2(x2)2xcos2xsin(x2)−sin2xcos(x2)​
FINAL ANSWER dydx=2xcos⁡2xsin⁡(x2)−sin⁡2xcos⁡(x2)cos⁡2(x2)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{2x\cos^2 x\sin(x^2) - \sin 2x\cos(x^2)}{\cos^2(x^2)}dxdy​=cos2(x2)2xcos2xsin(x2)−sin2xcos(x2)​

Technical Notes
📘 Box 1: Mathematical Foundations & Formula Reference
  • Quotient Rule: ddx(uv)=vu′−uv′v2\frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{u}{v}\right) = \frac{v u' - u v'}{v^2}dxd​(vu​)=v2vu′−uv′​.
  • Contrasting Composite Rules: ddx[(cos⁡x)2]=−2sin⁡xcos⁡x=−sin⁡2xvsddx[cos⁡(x2)]=−2xsin⁡(x2)\frac{d}{dx}[(\cos x)^2] = -2\sin x\cos x = -\sin 2x \quad \text{vs} \quad \frac{d}{dx}[\cos(x^2)] = -2x\sin(x^2)dxd​[(cosx)2]=−2sinxcosx=−sin2xvsdxd​[cos(x2)]=−2xsin(x2)
  • Double Angle Formula: 2sin⁡xcos⁡x=sin⁡2x2\sin x\cos x = \sin 2x2sinxcosx=sin2x.
⚠️ Box 2: Common Student Traps & Pitfalls
  • Confusion Between Functional Square & Argument Square: Treating cos⁡2x\cos^2 xcos2x and cos⁡(x2)\cos(x^2)cos(x2) as identical. They have fundamentally different derivative behaviors.
  • Double Negative Sign in Quotient Rule: −u⋅v′=−cos⁡2x⋅(−2xsin⁡(x2))=+2xcos⁡2xsin⁡(x2)- u \cdot v' = - \cos^2 x \cdot (-2x\sin(x^2)) = + 2x\cos^2 x\sin(x^2)−u⋅v′=−cos2x⋅(−2xsin(x2))=+2xcos2xsin(x2). Dropping a minus sign leads to an erroneous minus between the terms.
  • Cancelling Cosines Illegally: Cannot cancel cos⁡(x2)\cos(x^2)cos(x2) from the denominator with cos⁡x\cos xcosx in the numerator as their arguments are distinct.
🌐 Box 3: Real Domain & Differentiability Analysis
  • Denominator Zero Restriction: cos⁡(x2)≠0  ⟹  x2≠π2+kπ\cos(x^2) \neq 0 \implies x^2 \neq \frac{\pi}{2} + k\picos(x2)=0⟹x2=2π​+kπ for k≥0,k∈Zk \ge 0, k \in \mathbb{Z}k≥0,k∈Z.
  • Singular Points: Vertical asymptotes occur at x=±(2k+1)π2x = \pm \sqrt{(2k+1)\frac{\pi}{2}}x=±(2k+1)2π​​.
  • Differentiability: Smooth and differentiable on all open intervals between the consecutive roots of cos⁡(x2)=0\cos(x^2) = 0cos(x2)=0.
💡 Box 4: Logarithmic Differentiation Alternative
  • Taking natural log: ln⁡y=2ln⁡(cos⁡x)−ln⁡(cos⁡(x2))\ln y = 2\ln(\cos x) - \ln(\cos(x^2))lny=2ln(cosx)−ln(cos(x2))
  • Differentiating implicitly: 1ydydx=2(−sin⁡xcos⁡x)−(−sin⁡(x2)⋅2xcos⁡(x2))=−2tan⁡x+2xtan⁡(x2)\frac{1}{y}\frac{dy}{dx} = 2\left(\frac{-\sin x}{\cos x}\right) - \left(\frac{-\sin(x^2)\cdot 2x}{\cos(x^2)}\right) = -2\tan x + 2x\tan(x^2)y1​dxdy​=2(cosx−sinx​)−(cos(x2)−sin(x2)⋅2x​)=−2tanx+2xtan(x2)
  • Multiplying by y=cos⁡2xcos⁡(x2)y = \frac{\cos^2 x}{\cos(x^2)}y=cos(x2)cos2x​: dydx=cos⁡2xcos⁡(x2)[2xtan⁡(x2)−2tan⁡x]=2xcos⁡2xsin⁡(x2)−2sin⁡xcos⁡xcos⁡(x2)cos⁡2(x2)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{\cos^2 x}{\cos(x^2)}\left[2x\tan(x^2) - 2\tan x\right] = \frac{2x\cos^2 x\sin(x^2) - 2\sin x\cos x\cos(x^2)}{\cos^2(x^2)}dxdy​=cos(x2)cos2x​[2xtan(x2)−2tanx]=cos2(x2)2xcos2xsin(x2)−2sinxcosxcos(x2)​
